properties.name: app.cors.allowed-origin-patterns
properties.description: Comma-separated allowed origin patterns for CORS, e.g. http://localhost:3000.

properties.name: ai.gemini.enabled
properties.description: Enable or disable Gemini integration.

properties.name: ai.gemini.api-key
properties.description: Gemini API key used for authentication.

properties.name: ai.gemini.model
properties.description: Gemini model identifier.

properties.name: ai.gemini.endpoint
properties.description: Base endpoint for Gemini API requests.

properties.name: ai.gemini.timeout-seconds
properties.description: Timeout in seconds for Gemini API calls.

properties.name: ai.gemini.history-context-messages
properties.description: Maximum recent history messages included as context when asking Gemini.

properties.name: ai.gemini.history-return-messages
properties.description: Maximum history messages returned for a user when requesting chatbot history.

properties.name: ai.gemini.clinic-working-hours
properties.description: Clinic business hours text used as fixed chatbot business context.

properties.name: ai.gemini.clinic-hotline
properties.description: Clinic hotline used in chatbot business context.

properties.name: ai.gemini.clinic-address
properties.description: Clinic address used in chatbot business context.

properties.name: clinic.notification.receptionist.emails
properties.description: Comma-separated receptionist email addresses for new booking notifications.

properties.name: auth.forgot-password.otp.ttl-minutes
properties.description: Time to live in minutes for forgot-password OTP values.

properties.name: auth.forgot-password.otp.cooldown-seconds
properties.description: Cooldown in seconds between two OTP send requests.

properties.name: auth.forgot-password.otp.send-limit-window-minutes
properties.description: Window length in minutes for counting OTP send attempts.

properties.name: auth.forgot-password.otp.max-send-attempts
properties.description: Maximum OTP send attempts allowed in one send-limit window.

properties.name: auth.forgot-password.otp.max-invalid-attempts
properties.description: Maximum invalid OTP verification attempts before forcing a new OTP.

properties.name: auth.jwt.access-token.secret
properties.description: Secret key used to sign and verify access tokens.

properties.name: auth.jwt.refresh-token.secret
properties.description: Secret key used to sign and verify refresh tokens.

properties.name: auth.jwt.access-token.ttl-seconds
properties.description: Access token time-to-live in seconds.

properties.name: auth.jwt.refresh-token.ttl-days
properties.description: Refresh token time-to-live in days.

properties.name: payments.reconciliation.enabled
properties.description: Enable or disable the payment reconciliation job.

properties.name: payments.reconciliation.fixed-delay-ms
properties.description: Fixed delay in milliseconds between reconciliation runs.

properties.name: payments.reconciliation.initial-delay-ms
properties.description: Initial delay in milliseconds before first reconciliation run.

properties.name: payments.reconciliation.lookback-minutes
properties.description: Lookback window in minutes when scanning recent transactions.

properties.name: payments.refund-request.enabled
properties.description: Enable or disable the scheduled refund request email job.

properties.name: payments.refund-request.cron
properties.description: Cron expression used to trigger refund request emails.

properties.name: payments.refund-request.cutoff-hour
properties.description: Hour of day used to decide when a no-show payment is eligible for a refund request.

properties.name: payments.refund-request.cutoff-minute
properties.description: Minute of hour used with cutoff-hour for refund request eligibility.

properties.name: sepay.api.enabled
properties.description: Enable or disable SePay API checks in reconciliation.

properties.name: sepay.api.endpoint
properties.description: SePay API endpoint to list transactions.

properties.name: sepay.api.auth-token
properties.description: SePay API bearer token (without the 'Bearer ' prefix).

properties.name: sepay.api.query
properties.description: Optional query string to append to SePay API requests.

properties.name: sepay.api.require-amount-match
properties.description: Require SePay amount_in to meet or exceed invoice total.

properties.name: sepay.api.amount-tolerance
properties.description: Allowed tolerance when comparing SePay amount_in with invoice total.
